Name: Quality
Description: Sets the processing resolution for the ambient occlusion calculation. Higher quality provides more accurate and detailed results, but may increase computation time.

Flubs.Name: Low
Flubs.Description: Fastest processing with minimal detail. Suitable for previews or low-fidelity outputs.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced processing speed and detail. Recommended for general use.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: High detail with slower processing. Use when fine ambient occlusion is required.

Flubs.Name: Ultra
Flubs.Description: Maximum detail and accuracy. Best for final renders, but slowest to compute.

Name: Enhance
Description: Boosts the strength and clarity of the ambient occlusion effect, making shadows and depth more pronounced in the terrain.
